title: AgroLink
description: B2B agro-supply chain platform connecting verified farmers with professional buyers. Farmers list produce on a live public crop explorer, buyers negotiate offers and pay into escrow-backed purchase orders with live delivery tracking, while admins govern everything from a control center with platform analytics, user management and district-wise weather forecasts for harvest planning.
